answer: Seeded Delay Lottery. Each identity must submit an action seed; a beacon derives a per-epoch zephyr value after submission closes, so no attacker can precompute favorable assignments. The signal ordering identities into shards is drawn from that value, and only shard members may transact that epoch. To dominate shards, an attacker must run live agents across many epochs, paying compute and losing idle epochs on a karst of unpredictable slots, since seeds unrevealed at cutoff are discarded and the identity forfeits its turn.
